hero.label: [ Product engineer · Technical consultant ]
hero.intro: Bring me an idea, a messy system or a job you want automated. I take care of the technical side from start to finish and keep you updated in plain language.

services.title: Build your app or website
services.description: From the first idea to launch day, and improving it once real people use it.

services.title: Put AI to work
services.description: Assistants that answer calls and book appointments, and tools that read and sort documents for you.

services.title: Fix what's broken
services.description: Make slow or unreliable software stable, clean and documented, so it stops being a headache.

whyMe.title: Plain language, no jargon
whyMe.text: Every decision explained in words that make sense.

whyMe.title: A clear plan first
whyMe.text: You know what's being built, and when, before work starts.

whyMe.title: Progress you can see
whyMe.text: Regular updates you can click through and try.

whyMe.title: I stay after launch

process.title: We talk
process.text: You tell me what you need. I ask questions until the goal is clear.

process.title: I plan & build

paragraphs: I'm a product engineer and technical consultant. For about five years I've built software for clients and teams in healthcare, sales, hiring, education and food delivery.
I take full ownership of the work, from understanding the problem to launch and upkeep. I write things down and explain decisions clearly, so you're never left guessing.
